name: Beszel-Agent
description: Beszel Agent runs on each server you want to monitor. It collects system metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network) and Docker container stats, then reports them back to the Beszel Hub. Uses host networking (needed for host network stats) and reads Docker through the Docker Socket Proxy template.

paths.name: Agent Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the Beszel Agent (agent state). Runs as uid 65534: the host folder must be owned by 65534:65534.

variables.name: Hub URL
variables.description: The Beszel Hub URL the agent pushes to (WebSocket). Over Tailscale: the hub's Tailscale Service, e.g. https://beszel.<tailnet>.ts.net.

variables.name: Listen Port
variables.description: Address the agent listens on for the hub's SSH pull (fallback to push). With host networking, bind it to this host's tailnet IP so it isn't reachable on the LAN. Port must match the one entered in the Hub.

variables.name: Public Key
variables.description: The public SSH key generated by the Beszel Hub. Copy it from the 'System hinzufügen' dialog in the Hub UI (Öffentlicher Schlüssel field).

variables.name: Token
variables.description: The authentication token generated by the Beszel Hub. Copy it from the 'System hinzufügen' dialog in the Hub UI (Token field).

variables.name: Docker Host
variables.description: Read Docker through the read-only Docker Socket Proxy template (POST=0) instead of mounting docker.sock.
